analysis.headline: Fireworks AI breach exposes Notion and Uber driver data
analysis.summary: AI infrastructure firm Fireworks AI disclosed a breach traced to a compromised cloud provider, which exposed Notion AI chat transcripts and Uber driver license data. Techcrunch said it was Fireworks' second breach in two months; a later report put the number of affected Uber driver licenses at close to 150,000.
